data.summary: Data Governance and Regulatory Compliance professional with 6 years of experience in designing risk control frameworks, leading internal audits, and ensuring data quality, accuracy, and regulatory adherence across finance, FMCG, education, international trade, and M&A. Skilled in applying GAAP, IFRS, and COSO frameworks to assess internal controls, identify discrepancies, and strengthen governance practices. Experience in conducting risk assessments, managing UAT for cybersecurity and compliance integration, and translating governance findings into actionable reporting for leadership. Combines analytical rigor (Excel, Power BI, SQL, Collibra) with cross-functional stakeholder management to embed governance and compliance into business-critical processes. Experienced in mentoring analysts and training teams on audit, quality, and compliance standards.

responsibilities: Conducted comprehensive data analysis across sales, supply chain, and market research, providing insights for strategic planning and international expansion in the FMCG sector.
Performed data governance activities by assessing the quality and authenticity of data used in business and reporting decisions.
Studied reports and compliance requirements based on GAAP and IFRS principles, assessing internal controls frameworks to strengthen business process implementation.
Assessed market risk exposure and developed risk control reports to support better implementation of business processes in collaboration with the risk and compliance team.
Optimized export-import documentation and data management processes, ensuring compliance with international trade standards and reducing inefficiencies.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including operations, logistics, and compliance, to enable accurate reporting, streamline workflows, and improve decision-making.
Contributed to ERP implementation research, including cybersecurity requirements at the backend, to improve workflow integration, data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
Mapped and validated ERP data against backend data sources to ensure accurate ERP execution.
Developed business intelligence dashboards and interactive reports in Excel and Power BI to monitor performance metrics, customer demand, and operational KPIs.
Performed competitor and market intelligence research, supporting leadership in identifying new opportunities across domestic and international markets.
Collaborated and supported leadership in forecasting demand and planning resources for expansion into new growth markets with data-driven recommendations.
Collaborated with primary stakeholders to effectively lead the communications and discussions with product owners and clients.
Conducted detailed financial, market, and legal data analysis on mergers and acquisitions in banking, insurance, and mining industries.
Led data governance initiatives through internal audits, studying data discrepancies and forming risk reports to strengthen governance across financial datasets.
Developed a risk control framework for the identification and mitigation of risk during day-to-day business operations.
Analyzed financial reports based on GAAP and IFRS principles and studied internal control procedures on mergers and acquisitions across banking, insurance, and mining industries.
Implemented quality assurance protocols to identify and resolve data discrepancies, ensuring compliance and accuracy in reporting.
Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to support cybersecurity integration and cloud-based platform development, strengthening data governance, risk assessment, and operational efficiency.
Refined operational workflows to enhance regulatory compliance and boost efficiency across financial datasets.
Extracted, processed, and analyzed structured and unstructured datasets from global securities filings such as the SEC and ASX.
Authored analytical and research reports for regional and global markets, providing insights on transaction impact, compliance, and valuation trends.
Managed ETL processes supporting development of a cloud-based user interface for internal use, documenting associated security risks for stakeholder awareness.
Led automation projects using BOT tools to optimize complex financial data collection, enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
Collaborated with financial advisors and investment banks and primary stakeholders, ensuring data integrity for high-value transactions and leading stakeholder management.
Trained and mentored junior analysts in advanced analytics methods, predictive modelling, and reporting tools.
Maintained, monitored, and managed the data sets for M&A using data cataloging, defining broad and narrow categories in Collibra for data governance, where compliance and norms were documented.
Conducted data issue management by designing and maintaining workflow and lineage charts along with detailed data procedures using Collibra.
Collaborated with data architects and the data engineering team to design the pipelines and workflow of a process.
Teamed with the Risk Management regulatory and compliance team to actively track the risk mitigation and control process across the cluster.
Conducted data governance activities through fact-checking and research, identifying discrepancies across digital and blended content.
Prepared documentation on risks arising from identified discrepancies and designed risk control frameworks to eliminate them.
Advised management on strategy and implementation for risk management initiatives.
Developed and implemented quality assurance protocols for digital and blended content, ensuring compliance with academic and industry standards.
Conducted data-driven reviews to verify accuracy, consistency, and compliance of educational content across multiple platforms.
Supervised Learning Management System (LMS) integration and functionality testing, ensuring error-free content delivery and improved data quality.
Led and trained team members on quality standards and auditing practices, ensuring consistent, compliant content delivery.
Prepared project documentation, reports, and KPIs to track progress, ensuring stakeholder communication and on-time delivery.
Assisted the data governance team in crafting checklists to ensure the right data was collected for academic and analytics projects.
Coordinated with the data governance team to assess risk from defective data and frame strategies to control it.
Analyzed legal and educational documents to integrate compliance and regulatory frameworks into curriculum design.
Executed data management projects to identify the right sources of data for the team.
Designed educational content informed by detailed market research, improving user learning outcomes and interaction.
Performed competitor and market research to shape content strategies and align deliverables with client objectives.
Designed and delivered academic content, focusing on interactive and engaging methods to improve student performance.
Conducted assessments and performance reviews, using analytics to track learning outcomes.
Assisted in quality assurance of research outputs, ensuring compliance with client expectations.
Conducted secondary research and market analysis on industry-specific datasets to support business intelligence projects.
Compiled reports and insights for clients, focusing on competitor analysis and trend forecasting.
